name: M'Goun Geopark Museum

overview.title: The story of the M'Goun Geopark
overview.p1: The M'Goun Geopark Museum in Azilal presents fossils, dinosaur-related displays and the geological history of this UNESCO Global Geopark.
overview.p2: It is the ideal indoor complement to outdoor sites such as Iouaridene footprints, Ouzoud and the mountain valleys.
overview.p3: Check opening hours before you go. A short visit fits easily into a day that also includes Ouzoud or the road to Bin el Ouidane.

food.title: Where to eat in Azilal town
food.p1: Simple restaurants and cafés in Azilal centre serve tagines, grills and mint tea — a practical base before or after the museum.

food.li2: Cafés for coffee, juice and mint tea
food.li4: Ask your hotel for recommended addresses
food.p2: Cash remains useful for small local places.

q1.question: How much time for M'Goun Geopark Museum?
q1.answer: Plan at least the duration indicated in the info box; longer stays reward hikers.

q2.question: Is it suitable for children?
q2.answer: Yes with supervision on paths and near water or cliffs.

q3.question: Do I need a guide?
q3.answer: Not always required, but recommended for valleys and remote tracks.

q4.question: How to get there?
q4.answer: By road from Azilal, Marrakech or Beni Mellal; 4x4 helpful on some mountain roads.
